text: The Board confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated candidates.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following two candidates for appointment to the Board of Management of Cecil Community Centre, at pleasure of Council, for the term of office ending June 30, 2023, and until successors are appointed: Ben Rabinovitch Rabia Munir
